rules.name: Master of the Dark City
rules.description: If this unit is in your army and your Warlord, when determining who will take the first turn, you may roll 2D6 and take the highest result. At the start of the First Battle round, before the first turn begins, if you are going second, before the first turn begins, you may roll 2D6. If either dice is a 5 or 6, you may take the first turn instead.

rules.name: The Crystal Heart
rules.description: A model with this wargear is never affected by Psychic Powers and may not be targeted by attacks from Psychic Weapons.

rules.name: Precognisant
rules.description: This unit has a 4+ Invulnerable save. If this unit is in your army, you may re-deploy 3 units in your army at the start of the game before the first turn begins as if it were the deployment step

rules.name: Sculptor of Torments

rules.name: Contempt for Death
rules.description: The first time this unit would be slain and removed from play, it is not. Instead, this unit remains on the Battlefield and Heals all lost wounds.

rules.name: Master of Pain
rules.description: If this unit is in your army, whenever you earn a Pain Token (see Power From Pain special rule), you gain 2 Pain Tokens instead.

rules.name: Diabolical Sooth Sayer
rules.description: If Urien is your Warlord, he may re-roll 1 failed to hit, to wound or save roll per phase.

rules.name: Haemonculus Ancient
rules.description: A unit with this upgrade gains +1 to its Weapon Skill (WS), Toughness (T), Wounds (W) and Attacks (A) characteristics. The unit also gains the Battle-Hardened special rule.

rules.name: Deadly Arms
rules.description: This unit gains the Rending (6+) special rule on all Melee weapons it is equipped with.

rules.name: Leagues Apart
rules.description: A model with this special rule gains a number of bonus attacks each Combat Phase equal to the difference between this models Weapon Skill (WS) characteristic and the highest Weapon Skill (WS) characteristic in the target unit.

rules.name: Lord Hellion
rules.description: If this unit is your Warlord, all Hellion units in your army gain the Stubborn special rule

rules.name: Bones of the Seer
rules.description: If this unit is in your army, you may re-deploy up to 2 units in your army after deployment has finished and before the first turn begins.

rules.name: Twilight Shroud
rules.description: This unit and any attached unit to gains the benefit of Heavy Cover, even if they would not normally gain the benefits of Cover.

rules.name: Hunter of Heads
rules.description: If this unit is your Warlord, at the start of the game, select a single enemy unit with the Character special rulel in the enemy army. This unit may re-roll all hit & wound rolls against the designated unit.

rules.name: Mercenary Blade
rules.description: This unit may not be your Warlord.

rules.name: Bodyguard Muscle
rules.description: While a Sslyth model in is this unit, wound allocated to the unit must be allocated to Ssylth models first.

rules.name: Killing Beasts
rules.description: Ur-Ghul models have the Frenzy special rules. If Frenzy from an Ur-Ghul model is triggered, the entire unit gains the benefit of the Frenzy special rules.

rules.name: Armoured Scales
rules.description: A model with this wargear has a 4+ Armour save.

rules.name: Beast Tamer
rules.description: This unit can only join units with the Gladiator Beast keyword. This unit may join regardless of the unit even though it does not have the Beast type.

rules.name: Driving Lash
rules.description: Any attached Gladiator Beast unit gains +2 to its Attacks (A) Characteristics.

rules.name: Winged Hunter
rules.description: This unit gains the Skyfire special rule on all equipped shooting weapons when targeting enemy Aircraft type units.

sharedRules.name: Power from Pain
sharedRules.description:
When any unit (friend or foe) is slain/wrecked, 1 unit with this special rule within 12” of the slain/wrecked can gain 1 Pain Token. You may also instead opt to bank the Pain Token in your pool. At the start of each of your Movement Phases, you can allocate any number of Pain Tokens in your pool to units in your army with this special rule. A unit gains the following benefits based on how many Pain Tokens it has. The effects of all Tokens are cumulative:
• 1 Pain Token: A unit with 1 Pain Token gains the Feel no Pain (5+) special rule.
• 2 Pain Tokens: A unit with 2 Pain Token gains Fleet the special rule.
• 3 Pain Tokens: A unit with 3 Pain Tokens gains+1 to its Attacks (A) characteristic.
• 4 Pain Tokens: A unit with 4 Pain Tokens gains the Stubborn special rule.

sharedRules.name: Overlords Court
sharedRules.description: For every unit with this special rule, you may include 1 Court of the Archon without taking up a force organisation slot.

sharedRules.name: Arena Beasts
sharedRules.description: For each Beast Master unit in your army, you may field a unit with this special rule without taking up a Force Organization Slot.

sharedRules.name: Soul Leach
sharedRules.description: At the start of the Combat Phase, you can opt to Leech the equipped model’s soul. This weapon gains +1 to its Strength characteristic but gains the Gets Hot! special rule.

sharedRules.name: Agonizing Thorns
sharedRules.description: A unit which is hit by a weapon with this special rule gains a Thorn marker. A unit with a Thorn Marker halves its Movement (M) characteristic until the end of the Battle.

sharedRules.name: Pain Leech
sharedRules.description: Each time an enemy unit is hit by a weapon with this special rule, the model equipped with this weapon Heals 1 wound.

sharedRules.name: Netted
sharedRules.description: At the start of the combat phase, select a single enemy model in Melee range. Halve its Weapon Skill (WS) characteristic until the end of the phase.

rules.name: Grisly Trophies
rules.description: A model equipped with this Wargear gains the Fear (2) special rule.

rules.name: Force Field
rules.description: This wargear confers a 4+ Invulnerable save.

rules.name: Shadow Field
rules.description: This wargear confers a 2+ Invulnerable save. The first time a model with this wargear would fail an Invulnerable save using the Shadow Field, they may not use the Shadow Field for the rest of the game.

rules.name: Cluster Caltrops
rules.description: All Charges against a unit which includes a model with this wargear are treated as Disordered Charges.

rules.name: Combat Drugs
rules.description: A model with this wargear may opt to gain +1 to their Strength (S) characteristic and the Frenzy special rule until the start of your next Combat Phase.

rules.name: Clone Field
rules.description: A model with this wargear rolls at the start of each Player turn, roll a D3. The equipped model may ignore that many wounds allocated to it this turn.

rules.name: Soul Trap
rules.description: A model equipped with this wargear gains the Regeneration special rule.

rules.name: Grav Talon
rules.description: A model equipped with this wargear gains the Haywire (4+) special rule on its Hammer of Wrath Attacks.

rules.name: Dark Trophies
rules.description: A model with this wargear gains the Fear (1) special rule.

rules.name: Kabalite Armour
rules.description: A light body suit with segmented plates and barbs. It confers a 5+ Armour save.

rules.name: Wych Suit
rules.description: A tight fitting and flexible with one armoured side based on the wearers fighting posture. It confers a 6+ armour save. The equipped model has a 4+ Invulnerable save in the Combat Phase.

rules.name: Gnarl Skin
rules.description: A toughened hardened skin protects most flesh constructs and coven members. it confers a 6+ save.

rules.name: Ghost Plate
rules.description: A high protection but high mobility suit. Confers a 4+ armour save and 5+ invulnerable save.

rules.name: Incubus Warsuit
rules.description: This heavy traditional Warsuit is fitted with various interlocking plates. This confers a 3+ save.

rules.name: Armoured Carapace
rules.description: Engines of pain are often clad in finely wrought armoured shells. This confers a 3+ armour save.

rules.name: Light Weight Plating
rules.description: Light Weight plating used in many Dark Eldar vehicles. It confers a 3+ Armour save.

rules.name: Wings
rules.description: A model that is equipped with Wings increases its Movement (M) characteristic to 12”. The equipped unit gains the Hammer of Wrath (1), Fly, and Deep Strike special rules.

rules.name: Reaver Jetbike
rules.description:
A model that is equipped with Reaver Jetbike becomes the Jetbike type. The Reaver Jetbike increases the models Toughness (T) and Wounds
(W) characteristic by 1. This wargear confers a 4+ Armour save. The Reaver Jetbike is equipped with Blade Vanes and a Splinter Rifle.

rules.name: Sky Board
rules.description: A model equipped with a Skyboard increase their Movement (M) characteristic to 12”. In addition, the model gains the Hammer of Wrath (1), Fly and Deep Strike special rules. Sky Boards are equipped with Splinter Pods.

rules.name: Enhanced Either Sails
rules.description: A model equipped with this Wargear gains +4" to its Movement (M) characteristic.

rules.name: Retro Fire Jets
rules.description: Grants the equipped model the Deep Strike special rule

rules.name: Shock Prow
rules.description: When a model with this Wargear gains +1 to its Hammer of Wrath (x) special rule.

rules.name: Flicker Fields
rules.description: A model with this wargear has a 5+ Invulnerable save against Shooting attacks.

rules.name: Splinter Racks
rules.description: A unit with this Wargear and any embarked units gain the Linked special rule on all Splinter weapons they are equipped with. For the purposes of this special rule, a ‘Splinter weapon’ is any weapon listed under the ‘Splinter Weapon’ section of the wargear.

rules.name: Chain Snares
rules.description: A model equipped with this Wargear gains the Furious Charge special rule.

rules.name: Ancient Evil
rules.description: Enemy units within 3” of the Warlord halve their Leadership (LD) characteristic. This stacks with the effects of the Fear (x) Special rule.

rules.name: Hatred Eternal
rules.description: The Warlord and any attached unit gain the Hatred special rule

rules.name: Master Artisan
rules.description: The Warlord increases their Toughness (T) characteristic by 2 and gains the Battle-Hardened special rule.

rules.name: Master Nemesine
rules.description: The Warlord and any attached unit gain the Preferred Enemy special rule.

rules.name: Master Regenist
rules.description: The Warlord gains the Regeneration and Feel no Pain (5+) special rules. Additionally, the Warlord may re-roll the Dice for the Regeneration roll.

rules.name: Precision Blows
rules.description: The Warlord gains the Precision Hits special rule on all Melee type weapons they are equipped with.

rules.name: Quick Silver Fighter
rules.description: The Warlord gains the Sudden Strike and Hit & Run special rules.

rules.name: Soul Thirst
rules.description: The Warlord gains the Rage and Furious Charge special rules.

rules.name: Stimm Addict
rules.description: The Warlord gains +1 to their Weapon Skill (WS) and Attacks (A) characteristics but gains the Frenzy special rule.

rules.description: A model equipped with this Relic has a 3+ Armour Save. In addition, all enemy units within 3” of the bearer suffer -2 to their Leadership (LD) characteristic.
